repositories.description: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors
repositories.description_zh: 面向 agent coding CLI 的长期记忆方案，也方便在不同 agent 厂商或工具之间交接上下文。

repositories.description: MVT (Mobile Verification Toolkit) helps with conducting forensics of mobile devices in order to find signs of a potential compromise.
repositories.description_zh: MVT（Mobile Verification Toolkit）用于对移动设备做取证分析，帮助发现潜在入侵或被攻破的迹象。

repositories.description: AutoClip : AI-powered video clipping and highlight generation · 一款智能高光提取与剪辑的二创工具
repositories.description_zh: AutoClip 是一款 AI 驱动的视频高光提取与剪辑工具，面向二创和自动化短视频制作。

repositories.description: Project NOMAD is an offline-first knowledge and education server. Wikipedia, thousands of books, courses, maps, and optional local AI, all running on hardware you own with no internet required.
repositories.description_zh: Project NOMAD 是离线优先的知识与教育服务器，可在自有硬件上运行 Wikipedia、书籍、课程、地图和可选本地 AI，无需联网。
Laya 是多语言、非自回归的 System 1 决策引擎，可在单次前向推理中完成类型化决策。

repositories.description: Claude Code plugin that replaces the compaction summary with Jev decisions: every tool call and result is scored in one fast request, stale ones are dropped or truncated, everything kept stays verbatim.
repositories.description_zh: 一个 Claude Code 插件，用 Jev 决策替代压缩摘要：快速评分每次工具调用和结果，丢弃或截断过期内容，保留内容保持原文。

repositories.description: Z.ai's coding agent harness. Powerful, intelligent, extensible.
repositories.description_zh: Z.ai 的 coding agent 运行框架，强调强能力、智能化和可扩展性。

repositories.description: Open-source AI brand visibility and competitor reports. Official website: https://niubigeo.ai/ | Paid services: AI testing by real people and GEO optimization. Pricing: https://niubigeo.ai/pricing
repositories.description_zh: 开源的 AI 品牌可见度和竞品报告工具，配套提供人工 AI 测试与 GEO 优化服务。

repositories.description: Spotify, native and fast. One lightweight Rust app for your whole library, local playback, and Spotify Connect on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
repositories.description_zh: 轻量、原生且快速的 Spotify 客户端，用 Rust 构建，支持完整曲库、本地播放和跨 Linux、macOS、Windows 的 Spotify Connect。
面向 Mac 的 Photoshop 替代工具。
